metadata.description: Tmux-based supervision and orchestration tooling for Claude Code and Codex CLI agents.

plugins.name: tmux-agent
plugins.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, agy or grok CLI as supervised tmux workers: skills, wrappers, and the /workers function-hook mod that dispatches from an MCP tool and wakes the session when a worker finishes or fails to launch. Replaces the former tmux-agent-tools and tmux-agent plugins (see docs/tmux-agent-mod.md, Migration).
